artBrief: **Samurai travel / spring Japan.** A traveler steps through a courtyard gate with a notebook as cherry petals drift past. A luminous open doorway is the focal shape.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Samurai travel / spring Japan. A traveler steps through a courtyard gate with a notebook as cherry petals drift past. A luminous open doorway is the focal shape. Spring courtyard dominated by one luminous open gate and pink cherry branches. Small peaceful traveler with notebook, simple stepping stones; ivory, blush and jade palette.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
